u0: Initial safe state: the top lane has not been breached and the agent has not yet killed a zombie in this task. Keep the top lane secure and try to make a first kill; killing a zombie without a simultaneous top breach advances to u1 and earns the RM kill bonus, while any top-lane breach immediately fails to u2. If the episode ends here, the no-top-breach objective is still successful; side-lane breaches and plant tramples do not change this state.
u1: Safe progress state: at least one zombie has been killed and the top lane has not been breached. Continue guarding the top lane and killing zombies; additional kills leave the agent in u1, and only a top-lane breach moves it to terminal failure u2. If the episode ends in this state, the no-top-breach objective remains successful; side-lane breaches and plant tramples do not change it.
u2: Terminal failure state: a zombie has breached the top lane, so the no-top-breach objective is permanently lost. The RM stays in u2 with no route back to success; no later kill or other event can repair the breach, and further actions cannot change this failed outcome.
